propositions: LLMRunnerError raised by step-budget exhaustion in interpret_failure does not match the UnretryableOutputError catch clause in CompletionAgentStep.run, preventing bounded completion recovery from executing
A new LLMBudgetExhaustedError(LLMRunnerError) subclass must be defined and raised from interpret_failure's budget branch to enable type-based routing to recovery
The except clause in CompletionAgentStep.run must catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route it to _recover to activate bounded per-criterion recovery
Bounded completion recovery must preserve the budget diagnostic on self.failure_diagnostic even when recovery fails, so counters reach raise_completion_workflow_failure
Plain LLMRunnerError instances (not the budget subclass) must continue to propagate unchanged to maintain backward compatibility
Token exhaustion via UnretryableOutputError must retain its current recovery path behavior without modification
